name: Moonshot Boxes
description:
Moonshot Boxes is at the forefront of a retail investing revolution, democratising access to seed rounds that have traditionally been reserved for Venture Capitalist Funds and exclusive networks.

Our mission is to empower retail investors with unprecedented opportunities to participate in high-potential seed allocations that were previously inaccessible to most.

Additionally, we are redefining project funding by cultivating project-centric communities that enhance marketing and foster community growth.

With our expert guidance, we navigate projects through the complexities of the web3 space from strategic planning to a successful launch ensuring their transformational impact in the digital economy.
